products.title: Cucumber Seeds
products.description: Crisp cucumber variety for summer cultivation in Kashmir. High yield and disease resistant.

seasons.planting: Apr-Jul (open field), with protected early sowing in Mar

growing_instructions: Direct sow in warm soil on raised beds with full sun exposure.
Keep 45-60 cm spacing and provide trellis support for cleaner fruits.
Incorporate compost before sowing for steady vegetative growth.
care_instructions: Maintain consistent moisture; uneven watering can cause bitterness and misshapen fruits.
Mulch around vines to reduce evaporation and soil splash.
Hand-pollination can improve fruit set during cool or rainy spells.
Harvest tender fruits at regular intervals to sustain production.
